mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookings ( id, shipper_id, cargo_type, cargo_weight_kg, cargo_length_cm, cargo_width_cm, cargo_height_cm, cargo_quantity, cargo_description, origin_location, destination_location, requested_pickup_date, requested_delivery_date, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{record.id}, #{record.shipperId}, #{record.cargoType}, #{record.cargoWeightKg}, #{record.cargoLengthCm}, #{record.cargoWidthCm}, #{record.cargoHeightCm}, #{record.cargoQuantity}, #{record.cargoDescription}, #{record.originLocation}, #{record.destinationLocation}, #{record.requestedPickupDate}, #{record.requestedDeliveryDate}, #{record.status}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, shipper_id, cargo_type, cargo_weight_kg, cargo_length_cm, cargo_width_cm, cargo_height_cm, cargo_quantity, cargo_description, origin_location, destination_location, requested_pickup_date, requested_delivery_date, status, created_at, updated_at FROM bookings WHERE id = #{id}
